title: Junior QA Engineer (Manual Testing)
description:
Olá, nós somos o CESAR!

Somos um centro de inovação e de educação que há quase 30 anos forma pessoas e impulsiona organizações, potencializando suas estratégias digitais. Resolvemos problemas complexos e desafiadores em um ambiente de trabalho descontraído, descentralizado e repleto de benefícios para nossos colaboradores, que atuam como protagonistas, interagindo diretamente com clientes de escala global.

Como Junior QA Engineer (Manual Testing) , sua missão será realizar validações manuais durante o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento do produto ou solução, sob orientação e acompanhamento, de modo a atender os objetivos pré-estabelecidos do projeto, com foco no aprendizado e autodesenvolvimento pautado nos princípios da cultura de qualidade da organização, que tem como base o pensamento crítico, atenção a detalhes e natureza preventiva. Topa? Vamos nessa!

Esperamos que você…

  • Realize validações do produto/solução em alinhamento à estratégia de teste definida, através da execução de testes funcionais e não-funcionais;
  • Contribua com as atividades de planejamento, análise, execução e reporte, de forma a adquirir boas práticas de qualidade de forma ampla;
  • Atue com times multifuncionais nos processos e abordagens relativos à qualidade por todo ciclo de vida do produto/projeto;
  • Reporte e acompanhe a reprodução e resolução de falhas e melhorias, visando a estabilidade e usabilidade do produto/solução.

Precisamos que você tenha…

  • Conhecimento sólidos de Teste de Software, no âmbito funcional e não-funcional;
  • Experiência em metodologias de testes e padrões de qualidade;
  • Tenha conhecimento em testes mobile;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, leitura e escrita;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em nossos escritórios (Recife/PE).

É legal que você…

  • Tenha conhecimento de testes de hardware;
  • Tenha algum conhecimento em características de qualidade de Áudio;
  • Tenha algum conhecimento em eletrônica básica.

Aqui no CESAR, nós temos algumas práticas que proporcionam uma rotina mais positiva para a pessoa colaboradora:

  • Horário flexível;
  • Estrutura horizontal;
  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Cultura voltada para a Diversidade & Inclusão, onde você pode ser livre pra ser quem é!

Gostou? Espera só para conferir nosso pacote variado de benefícios:

title: Microsoft Migration Specialist
description:

13 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Microsoft Migration Specialist role at Braintrust

About Pyyne

Job Description
About Pyyne
 Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.
At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.
Job Summary
Pyyne is seeking a Microsoft Migration Specialist for a contractor position to lead a large-scale migration from Google Workspace (Gmail) to Microsoft 365 for one of our enterprise clients in the insurance sector.
This role is pivotal to ensuring a seamless and secure transition of email, calendars, contacts, and collaboration tools to the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Google-to-Microsoft migrations and be comfortable working in enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders and complex dependencies.
Key Responsibilities
Migration Planning & Execution:

  • Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of the Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration.
  • Analyze existing Gmail and Google Drive environments to define migration scope, approach, and timeline.
  • Execute migrations of mail, calendars, contacts, and files using best-in-class tools and methodologies.
  • Utilize tools such as BitTitan MigrationWiz or Google Workspace Migration for Microsoft Exchange (GWMME).
Cloud Integration & Configuration:
  • Set up and configure Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Establish user accounts, mail flow rules, retention policies, and security configurations.
  • Manage identity synchronization with Azure Active Directory and configure appropriate access policies.
Troubleshooting & Support:
  • Identify and resolve data transfer issues, permission conflicts, and post-migration inconsistencies.
  • Serve as an escalation point during and after the migration to ensure minimal business disruption.
  • Document procedures and provide training or handoff support to internal IT teams.
Stakeholder Communication:
  • Work closely with client IT teams, project managers, and business stakeholders to ensure clarity and alignment throughout the project.
  • Provide regular updates, status reports, and risk assessments during the project lifecycle.
Qualifications
Experience & Skills:
  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise IT, including at least 2 successful migrations from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365.
  • In-depth knowledge of:
    • Exchange Online and Microsoft 365 configuration.
    • Google Workspace admin console and architecture.
    • Identity and access management via Azure AD.
    • Migration tools like BitTitan, GWMME, or CloudMigrator.
  • Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of security, compliance, and email archiving best practices in Microsoft 365.
Soft Skills:
  • Ability to lead and manage large-scale projects independently.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a user-focused mindset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
Location:
  • Remote-first
The Ideal Candidate
 You are a technically strong, execution-oriented migration expert with specific experience moving enterprise clients from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365. You enjoy working in dynamic environments and understand the importance of a seamless user experience during complex transitions. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and confident in taking ownership of end-to-end delivery.
Benefits
  • Competitive hourly contractor rate based on experience.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a business-critical migration for a major insurance organization.
  • Potential for future engagements with Pyyne’s expanding enterprise client portfolio

description:
About Sensia

Sensia combines the pioneering process automation, real-time control, and IoT technologies of Rockwell Automation with the measurement, instrument, software, and analytics capabilities of Schlumberger. With domain expertise in oil and gas and artificial lift, Sensia is a leading automation provider in oil and gas production, transportation, and processing, serving over 1,000 experts across more than 80 countries. As the first fully integrated oilfield automation solutions provider, we aim to make oil and gas operations safer, more productive, and more profitable through digitalization and seamless automation.

We seek top talent with a collaborative mindset, exceptional problem-solving skills, and innovative solutions to join our team.

Job Description

Position Activities

  1. Maintain automation systems, prepare technical documentation, perform software programming, testing, and commissioning at customer facilities.
  2. Perform offshore field services and systems engineering for process and safety systems, HMI, instrumentation, networks, etc.
  3. Design moderate to complex architectures for new projects and analyze existing systems for intervention.
  4. Manage development stages of automation systems: requirements gathering, detailed design, software programming, factory testing, and commissioning at customer sites.

Requirements

  • Experience as an Industrial Automation Maintenance Engineer with Rockwell Automation products in the oil & gas industry (PowerFlex, Drives, Logix Platform, Trusted, Advanced, PLC development, industrial components, networks, etc.).
  • Experience in field installation and commissioning of automation systems and networks.
  • Previous experience in oil & gas automation projects or related fields.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written.

Education Requirements

  • Degree in Engineering, Technology, or Technician in Industrial Automation, Electronics, Electrical, or equivalent.

Experience Requirements

  • Mandatory: Good knowledge of Rockwell Automation products.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience.
  • CREA certification.
  • Residence in São Paulo/SP region.
  • Availability for offshore work: on-call for 14/21 days depending on the project.
  • Experience in the oil & gas industry.
  • Knowledge of industrial networks including Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, among others.
  • Willingness to travel and work at customer sites.
  • Ability to work under high pressure conditions and face-to-face with customers.

Join to apply for the Support Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing, with a global distributed team of over 1200 colleagues in more than 75 countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet a few times a year in various global locations to align on strategy and execution.

The regional Support Managers lead world-class Support teams—resolving complex technical issues for customers worldwide on Ubuntu Server, Desktop, and public cloud. They embody customer focus—ensuring customer satisfaction—and technical excellence—keeping the support team updated with the latest technology and troubleshooting efficiently. We seek managers for both our Cloud Support Group and Devices Support Group.

  • Collaborating with leadership on growth and transformation initiatives

  • Extensive CLI experience with Linux at a technical level (Support, Development, Implementation)
  • Leadership and team management experience
  • Ability to perform under pressure with a strong customer focus

  • Proven contributions to Open Source projects
  • Software development experience
  • Experience working in support organizations

What we offer colleagues:

  • Additional benefits reflecting our values and local needs

Canonical pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu—the platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We recruit globally, uphold high standards, and foster a remote work culture since 2004. Working here challenges you to think differently, learn new skills, and excel.

description:
Join to apply for the Senior Delivery Consultant - Databases role at Amazon Web Services (AWS) .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Description

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior Delivery Consultant - Databases to join our team at AWS. In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Senior Delivery Consultant - Databases, you will work with customers to migrate their database environments to AWS, architecting complex, scalable, and secure database solutions tailored to meet specific needs. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies.

As a trusted advisor, you will guide customers on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts helping customers realize their desired business outcomes using AWS Cloud. We work with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud initiatives, providing tailored guidance and solutions across various industries.

Key job responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS database solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support during project delivery
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  • Acting as a trusted advisor on industry trends and emerging technologies
  • Sharing knowledge through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all preferred qualifications, we encourage you to apply. If your career is unconventional or includes alternative experiences, don’t hesitate to apply.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive cloud platform, trusted by startups to Global 500 companies for its innovative products and services.

Inclusive Team Culture

We foster a culture of inclusion through employee-led affinity groups and ongoing learning events, celebrating our differences.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We offer resources for professional development, mentorship, and career advancement to help you grow as a professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value flexibility and support work-life harmony to enable success at work and at home.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years in cloud architecture and implementation
  • 5+ years working with relational or open-source databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Knowledge of non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Effective communication skills in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of customer-facing, large-scale implementation experience
  • Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
  • Expertise in performance optimization and cost management in cloud environments
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced setting
  • AWS Professional certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional)
  • Knowledge of primary AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, etc.)

FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
The Opportunity
"As an AI Pre-Sales Scientist you’ll be responsible for communicating to clients on FICO’s AI/Gen AI and machine learning/analytic methods and latest innovations to drive sales efforts for FICO’s solutions that manage risk, fight financial crime, build profitable customer relationships, and meet regulatory requirements. As an AI/Gen AI and machine learning/analytic domain expert, you will engage customers at mid-level management and technical levels to ensure strong knowledge of FICO’s product differentiation and unique intellectual property (IP). Also, you will support direct sales in the communication of FICO’s differentiation of FICO’s AI/Gen AI capabilities via presentations and product deep-dive sessions. Whenever the opportunity arises, you will gather customer feedback to inform and lead the creation of new IP to guide FICO’s product and business development roadmap." - Analytics VP
What You'll Do

  • You will elevate how we engage with internal and external business on topics related to AI/Gen AI.
  • You will be accountable for driving strong customer engagement and understanding of FICO’s AI/Gen AI product offerings, understanding customer needs and relating those needs to machine learning/analytic methods utilized in FICO’s AI/Gen AI products.
  • You will also bring new requirements back to the product development team for consideration as part of our AI/Gen AI product roadmaps.
  • You will participate in research projects to identify emerging trends and technologies in AI/Gen AI space that can help us develop new products and expand our IP library.
  • You will focus on external communications bringing to our customers move visibility of the AI/Gen AI innovations and process behind the innovations, including speaking engagements, collateral development, presentations, and social medial messaging.
  • You will create proof of concepts, product demonstrations, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and prepare sales package proposals.

What We're Seeking
  • MSc degree in computer science, engineering, physics, statistics, mathematics, operations research or natural science fields with hands-on related experience in data science, including AI/Gen AI and machine learning.
  • Experience analyzing large data sets and applying data-cleaning techniques along with performing statistical analyses leading to the understanding of the structure of data sets.
  • Proven and demonstrable experience with at least three of the following machine learning algorithms: neural networks, logistic regression, non-linear regression, random forests, decision trees, support vector machines, linear/non-linear optimization.
  • Experience working with Java and Python, and strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
  • Experience with AI and Gen AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow or PyTorch).
  • Experience with at least one cloud-based platform (e.g., AWS SageMaker or Azure Machine Learning).
  • Adept at translating business problems into solution statements.
  • Strong communication skills and bilingualism/multilingualism are highly desirable.
  • Open for travel (50% — national and international travel).

Our Offer to You
  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  • Credit Scoring — FICO Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
  • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
  • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Segurança: Comprometimento com as práticas de segurança e uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI) para garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro.

Comunicação: Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe, colaborando com outros profissionais para garantir a eficiência operacional.

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

This is an opportunity to lead a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions across public clouds and data centers. The role involves working with a broad spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu to virtualization, private cloud, Kubernetes, and advanced open source solutions like MLops platforms and data platforms. As Canonical expands into new industries such as telecom, finance, healthcare, and media, we develop new open source solutions tailored to their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers, comfortable troubleshooting technical issues and engaging in technical presales. They should contribute technically but focus more on shaping team direction, focus, and delivery. We also focus on growing management skills and soft skills in our engineers.

Our goal is to make open source easier, reliable, and secure, aiming to provide 'most software to most companies'. We select engineers globally for brilliance and motivation, and our managers help teams achieve their potential and take pride in their results.

The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical

The team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical works directly with customers to design private and public cloud solutions tailored to workload needs. Technologies include on-premise solutions like Openstack, MicroCloud, Ceph, and deployable solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL. Managers and team members deploy, test, and hand over solutions, and participate in presales to advise during sales processes.

The manager is responsible for line management, career guidance, developing engineering talent, representing the team technically, and driving collaboration with other teams and customers. Active participation in presales is also expected.

Location

This role is home-based, managing a team in your time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting technologies and acting as a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in your time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and provide career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and products to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and promote best engineering and organizational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on goals and projects
  • Participate in leadership team collaborations

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies (Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph)
  • Practical Linux and networking skills
  • Experience in technical presales
  • Dynamic personality, proactive in new projects and interacting with people
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Passion for developing and growing people
  • Experience leading, coaching, and mentoring engineers
  • Organized, ensuring timely, high-quality results
  • Strong academic background
  • Willingness to travel up to 40%, attending events and meetings

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language (Spanish or French) preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience with external partnerships
  • Stakeholder engagement with internal teams and engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

Our compensation considers location, experience, and performance, with annual reviews and performance bonuses. Benefits include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • USD 2,000 yearly learning and development budget
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, parental leave, Employee Assistance Programme
  • Travel opportunities and upgrades for company events

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster excellence. Since 2004, as a remote-first company, we challenge you to think differently, learn new skills, and innovate.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion, offering fair consideration regardless of background or identity.

GS 16

Requirements and skills

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Desejável conhecimento em: Pacote Office; Matemática Financeira; Alavancas Comerciais; Técnicas de Negociação;

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida; VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional; Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual); Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada; Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual; Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano; Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! description:
Descrição da empresa

Na Turner & Townsend somos apaixonados por fazer a diferença. Isso significa entregar melhores resultados para nossos clientes, ajudar nossos colaboradores a realizar seu potencial e fazer nossa parte para criar uma sociedade próspera, inclusiva e mais sustentável.

Todos os dias, ajudamos nossos principais clientes globais a entregar projetos ambiciosos e altamente técnicos, em mais de 110 escritórios em 50 países em todo o mundo.

Nossa equipe é dinâmica, inovadora e focada no cliente. Nossos clientes valorizam nossa abordagem proativa, profundidade de experiência, integridade e a qualidade que entregamos.

Como resultado, nosso time tem o prazer e orgulho de atuar em alguns dos projetos mais empolgantes do mundo.

Descrição do emprego

A modalidade desta contratação é PJ/Contractor.

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Contratos, Infraestrutura, altamente qualificado, para se juntar à nossa equipe em Campinas, Brasil. Neste papel, você será responsável por supervisionar e gerenciar contratos relacionados a projetos de infraestrutura, garantindo conformidade e otimizando o desempenho dos contratos.

  • Desenvolver, negociar e gerenciar contratos de infraestrutura complexos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida.
  • Analisar os termos e condições dos contratos para identificar potenciais riscos e oportunidades.
  • Colaborar com partes interessadas internas para garantir que os requisitos do contrato sejam atendidos e as entregas sejam alcançadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho do contrato e implementar ações corretivas quando necessário.
  • Realizar análises financeiras e previsões relacionadas aos orçamentos e despesas dos contratos.
  • Garantir a conformidade com a legislação e regulamentos contratuais brasileiros.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com fornecedores, contratantes e equipes internas.
  • Implementar e manter sistemas e processos de gestão de contratos.
  • Fornecer relatórios regulares sobre o status do contrato, riscos e métricas de desempenho.
  • Participar da resolução de disputas relacionadas a contratos e gestão de reivindicações.

Qualificações

  • Bacharel em Engenharia ou áreas afins, com ampla experiência em gestão de contratos, preferencialmente em infraestrutura
  • Conhecimento profundo da legislação e dos regulamentos brasileiros sobre contratos
  • Excelentes habilidades de negociação e comunicação
  • Proficiência em software de gerenciamento de contratos e no Microsoft Office, com capacidade comprovada de analisar informações contratuais e financeiras complexas
  • Sólidas habilidades organizacionais e de gerenciamento de projetos
  • Fluência em inglês
  • É altamente desejável ter experiência com projetos de infraestrutura e contratos relacionados

Informações Adicionais

Nossas pessoas inspiradas compartilham nossa visão e missão. Nós fornecemos um ótimo lugar para trabalhar, onde cada pessoa tem a oportunidade e voz para afetar a mudança.

Queremos que nossos colaboradores tenham sucesso tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Para apoiar isso, promovemos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, produtivo e flexível que respeite o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.

Turner & Townsend é um empregador de oportunidades iguais.

Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários e incentivar ativamente candidaturas de todos os setores da comunidade.

title: Gerente de Projetos - Energias Renováveis
description:
Sobre Nós
A Marca Ambiental atua em parceria com as diversas empresas que fazem parte do seu Parque de Ecoindústrias para promover a solução completa e a reciclagem de diferentes tipologias de resíduos: orgânicos, da construção civil, pneus, óleo de cozinha pós consumo, plástico, vidro, além da geração de energia por meio do biogás.
No Parque de Ecoindústrias da Marca Ambiental, os mais diversos resíduos ganham nova vida e, valorizados, voltam à cadeia produtiva de forma circular.
GERENTE DE PROJETOS - ENERGIAS RENOVÁVEIS
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Projetos para fortalecer o nosso time de Energias Renováveis.
Buscamos um profissional com habilidades para planejar, executar e supervisionar projetos do setor de energias renováveis, que podem incluir a construção de usinas, implementação de sistemas de distribuição, eficiência energética e desenvolvimento de tecnologias inovadoras.
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
  • Responsável por planejar, executar e supervisionar projetos do setor de energias renováveis, que podem incluir a construção de usinas, implementação de sistemas de distribuição, eficiência energética e desenvolvimento de tecnologias inovadoras;
  • Planejar todas as etapas dos projetos de energia, definir o escopo, objetivos, cronograma e orçamento dos projetos, assegurando que estejam alinhados com as metas estratégicas da empresa e as regulamentações do setor;
  • Liderar e gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo engenheiros, técnicos, especialistas e outros profissionais, garantindo que todos trabalhem em conjunto para atingir os objetivos do projeto;
  • Manter comunicação constante com todas as partes interessadas, como clientes, fornecedores, órgãos reguladores e comunidades locais, para garantir que as expectativas sejam atendidas e que haja transparência no andamento do projeto;
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade técnica e econômica, avaliando a viabilidade dos projetos em termos de custos, retorno sobre investimento e impacto ambiental;
  • Solicitar materiais, serviços e controle de contratos;
  • Acompanhar o progresso do projeto, realizando ajustes conforme necessário para garantir que os prazos e orçamentos sejam cumpridos, além de assegurar a qualidade dos resultados;
  • Identificar e avaliar riscos associados ao projeto, desenvolvendo planos de mitigação para minimizar impactos negativos;
  • Elaborar relatórios de status e documentação técnica, apresentando resultados e progresso para a alta administração e outras partes interessadas;
  • Assegurar que todos os aspectos do projeto estejam em conformidade com as normas e regulamentações do setor de energia, incluindo licenciamento ambiental e segurança.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Conhecimento na área de Energia será um diferencial.
INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Abono assiduidade;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Parceria com Instituição de ensino;
  • Day-off no mês do seu aniversário.

title: Instrumentation & Controls Instructor
description:
Job Description

Wood is currently recruiting for an Instrumentation & Controls Instructor with a strong understanding of operations training requirements to be based in Basra, Iraq on a 28 Days on / 28 Days Off Rotation.

Responsibilities

Instructor Duties & Responsibilities:

  1. Prepare training programs and manage presentation materials / equipment.
  2. Perform Gap analysis on the competency level of the company workforce and develop a training program closing the gaps as per the company competency level requirements.
  3. Deliver training efficiently with strong focus on Oil & Gas assets.
  4. Present training material in a professional, interesting, and stimulating manner.
  5. Develop and publish different levels of training programs to satisfy the company needs which include Classroom and OJT activities.
  6. Deliver Individual competency development training with a holistic approach which includes SHE and WMS considerations in accordance with the client and Iraq government regulations as well as industry systems as applicable.
  7. Assess the students’ capabilities and modify program material / presentation as needed to maximize the student’s learning.
  8. Maintain program performance, completion, attendance, evaluation records and perform LMS data input functions as defined by the client Training Management.
  9. Interface and coordinate training activities with the Company and other personnel to effectively achieve program presentations and completion objectives.
  10. Ensure all students engage positively in learning experience.
  11. Assist and encourage students who experience difficulties.
  12. Operate training facilities instructional and presentation equipment.
  13. Ensure all developed training material is presented for archiving by the Document Controller.

Craft Assessment & Responsibilities

  1. Work with Training Supervisor and Discipline Superintendent to establish/review assessment criteria.
  2. Conduct assessments on O&M personnel to establish gaps in craft competencies.
  3. Conduct assessments in a professional, interesting, and stimulating manner.
  4. Ensure all students engage positively in assessment experience.
  5. Assist and encourage students to provide evidence of prior formal training and previous work experience.
  6. Modify assessment process as needed to maximize students’ involvement.
  7. Maintain up to date records of all assessments planned and completed.
  8. Ensure all developed assessment material is presented for archiving by the Document Controller.

Qualifications

Education : University Degree: Any discipline & Accredited Assessor license.

Technical Skills Required

  1. Strong oil & gas upstream operational, technical, or supervisory background.
  2. Knowledgeable of / competent with basic upstream oil & gas operational programs.
  3. Competent / experienced with upstream oil & gas and craft training programs.
  4. Strong training presentation, coordination, evaluation, & planning skills.
  5. Competent computer skills; presentation, spreadsheets, document preparation.
  6. Proven competence with procedure development and presentation software.
  7. Has proven ability to communicate technical information and procedures to students of varying levels.

Personal Skills

  1. A minimum of 10 years in a similar role with 5 years’ experience OJT / Classroom Training.
  2. Minimum of 10 years of experience in Upstream and Downstream businesses.
  3. Preferably holds an accredited Assessor Qualification.
  4. Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  5. Good interpersonal skills, able to work in multi-culture and multi-company environments.
  6. Bi-Lingual (English / Arabic) ability preferred.
  7. Candidates must have a Basra Residency Card.

description:
Join to apply for the AI Agent Engineer role at Quero Educação

Join to apply for the AI Agent Engineer role at Quero Educação

Somos uma EdTech brasileira, desenvolvemos produtos e soluções educacionais para alunos instituições de ensino. Nosso principal produto é a Quero Bolsa, maior portal de educação do Brasil, marketplace que ajuda futuros alunos do Brasil inteiro a escolherem o curso ideal por um preço que possam pagar. Com a Quero, milhões de brasileiros podem comparar faculdades, cursos e escolas, fazer a matrícula e pagar o menor preço pelos seus estudos - tudo online, a qualquer hora.
Na Quero Educação, estamos construindo agentes inteligentes para revolucionar o atendimento ao cliente e a experiência dos nossos usuários. Nosso foco está em criar sistemas autônomos, baseados em modelos de linguagem (LLMs), capazes de responder, decidir e agir com naturalidade e segurança.
Se você é apaixonado por inteligência artificial aplicada, quer trabalhar com os melhores modelos e ferramentas do mercado e tem interesse em transformar experiências de atendimento com tecnologia de ponta, essa vaga é para você.
RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implantar agentes inteligentes baseados em LLMs
  • Criar fluxos de interação autônoma entre agentes, sistemas internos e usuários finais
  • Integrar os agentes a APIs, sistemas legados e fontes de dados diversas
  • Desenvolver pipelines de treinamento, ajuste fino (fine-tuning) e avaliação de agentes
  • Prototipar e iterar rapidamente com foco em entrega de valor
  • Colaborar com as áreas de produto, engenharia e dados na definição de casos de uso
  • Participar ativamente da evolução da stack de inteligência artificial da Quero
REQUISITOS
  • Experiência com LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares) e agentes baseados em linguagem
  • Proficiência em Python e experiência com LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ferramentas equivalentes
  • Conhecimento em orquestração de agentes e fluxos multi-etapas (ReAct, ToolUse, AutoGen)
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e engenharia de prompts
  • Conhecimento em processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), embeddings e vetorizadores (OpenAI, Cohere ou similares)
  • Experiência em integração com APIs REST e sistemas externos
  • Vivência com testes, registro de logs e avaliação de qualidade em sistemas de inteligência artificial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial, em São José dos Campos/SP
DIFERENCIAIS
  • Experiência com sistemas multiagente e pipelines de workflow complexos
  • Conhecimento de frameworks como CrewAI, LangGraph ou AutoGen
  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente, experiência do cliente (CX) ou automação de processos conversacionais
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source de inteligência artificial
  • Participação em pesquisas ou publicações na área de inteligência artificial aplicada
BENEFÍCIOS
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação (Bradesco, Policlin ou Santa Casa).
  • Convênio Odontológico de cobertura nacional (Uniodonto, sem coparticipação).
  • TotalPass.
  • Restaurante na Quero, com almoço delicioso.
  • Incentivo à psicoterapia.
  • Incentivo aos estudos (parceria com Alura, isenção da taxa de pré-matrícula dos cursos da Quero Bolsa etc).
  • PLR (bônus pago semestralmente, de acordo com atingimento de metas individuais e da empresa).
  • Antecipação de férias.
  • Feriados municipais e estaduais são móveis, podendo folgar no dia ou adiar/antecipar dentro do mesmo ano.

Consistently ranked among the top ten “Best Firms to Work For” and Engineering News-Record’s top 50 firms worldwide, Langan attracts and retains the best talent in the industry. Employees thrive at Langan, a firm that fosters an inclusive and supportive work environment for all; prioritizes wellbeing, health, and safety; encourages volunteerism and philanthropy; offers workplace flexibility, along with carbon-neutral office spaces; and empowers individuals to contribute their skills and knowledge to make impactful contributions.

Job Summary

Langan is seeking an entry-level Civil Engineer to join its collaborative team in Doylestown, PA. This individual will serve a key function in providing assistance with the planning, design, and permitting of civil engineering, land development, and infrastructure projects. In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain experience in site/civil engineering design for mixed-use developments, shopping centers, residential, higher education, federal, and other exciting land development projects.

Job Responsibilities

  • Assist with the planning, design and permitting of civil engineering, land development and infrastructure projects;
  • Assist with the preparation and modification of various engineering documents including reports, specifications, plans, construction schedules, cost estimates and design plans for projects using engineering and design software (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, etc.) and equipment;
  • Effectively use reports, maps, drawings, engineering plans, test and aerial photographs to assess soil composition, terrain, hydrological characteristics and topographical and geologic data and their impact on the planning and design of projects;
  • Recommend new approaches and ideas that continuously improve efficiency and services performed;
  • Apply knowledge and techniques of engineering and advanced mathematics;
  • Collaborate with team members on project tasks and assignments; and
  • Perform other duties as requested.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering;
  • 0-2 years of work-related experience;
  • EIT Certification or current registration for the FE exam preferred;
  • Prior relevant internship or professional experience in site/civil design, including site planning, grading, stormwater management, drainage, and soil erosion;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities;
  • Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment; and
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday with occasional evenings and weekends.

Langan provides a rich array of programs and benefits to help its employees advance their careers and enhance the quality of their lives. Our comprehensive compensation package includes: full-time employment company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and paid pregnancy disability leave; 401(k)/Roth with company match; paid time off including parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses; and educational reimbursement.

Langan offers employee resource groups; flexible work schedules; extensive training; wellness programs; buddy and mentoring programs; and much more!

Langan is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We believe that an inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our employees.

Sobre a empresa

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras, ajudando-os a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas em 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG). title: Software Engineer, Risk
description:
Brex: AI-powered Spend Platform

Brex is the AI-powered spend platform that helps companies manage their expenses with integrated corporate cards, banking, global payments, and intuitive software for travel and expenses. Thousands of companies, from startups to enterprises—including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass—use Brex to control spending, reduce costs, and increase efficiency globally.

Working at Brex means pushing your limits, challenging the status quo, and collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture, empowering you with the tools, resources, and support needed to grow your career.

Our mission is to reimagine financial systems to help growing companies realize their full potential. As the financial OS, we develop software and services that disrupt traditional institutions with innovative products and experiences tailored to our customers' ambitions.

Engineering at Brex

The Engineering team encompasses Data, IT, Security, and Software, responsible for creating innovative products and infrastructure for internal and external users. Our autonomous, collaborative teams are eager to learn, teach, and improve continuously. We aim to build robust, scalable systems that enable Brex's rapid growth and help our customers succeed. Engineers take pride in their work, ownership, and accountability, knowing that today’s software forms the foundation for future systems.

What You’ll Do

We seek passionate individuals to build data-driven risk management systems. You will gain exposure to all aspects of financial crime prevention, from developing customer-facing experiences to collaborating with data scientists to integrate models into production. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential, as the role involves interfacing with multiple systems across Brex.

You will work on high-impact projects, maintaining data integrity, ensuring compliance, and driving financial outcomes. This role offers specialized knowledge in risk management and contributes to building trusted financial services while safeguarding customers, the platform, and market integrity.

Where You’ll Work

This role is based in our São Paulo office. You must be willing to work in the office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays, starting the week of September 1st, 2025, when our São Paulo office opens.

Responsibilities

  1. Ensure high-quality data for decision systems, using risk vendors and internal models to provide actionable insights for risk management and customer experience improvements.
  2. Develop low-latency decision systems for risk assessment during onboarding, payments, authentication, and in-app processes, leveraging machine learning models.
  3. Build in-product tools to enhance decision systems while making risk management unobtrusive.
  4. Create systems for comprehensive customer due diligence, including KYC, sanctions, adverse media, PEP, and AML monitoring.

Minimum Requirements

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Kotlin, Go, Python, or Java. Experience with Kotlin is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of Machine Learning and experience working with ML-integrated systems, supporting model deployment and feature pipelines.
  • Interest in data-driven systems, solving complex problems, and risk management (prior risk experience is not required).
  • Aptitude for building effective, user-centric tools for internal teams.
  • Strong ownership, motivation to protect customers, and high standards.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to work in the São Paulo office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or publications.
  • Experience with low-latency decisioning systems at scale and deploying models.

Note: Job-seekers should be cautious of malicious actors seeking personal data. Brex recruiters will only contact candidates via LinkedIn or email from the @brex.com domain. Beware of outreach from other sources claiming to be from Brex.

title: Senior Staff Android Software Engineer (Poatek - Brazil applicants)
description:
Tech Lead (Android)

São Paulo-SP, Brazil or Porto Alegre-RS, Brazil

Who We Are

In 2021, Poatek was acquired by WillowTree, an award-winning digital product consultancy recognized as one of the fastest growing and best places to work in the United States. Now a TELUS International company , with offices across the globe, we continue to partner with the world’s leading brands, such as the NBA, Capital One, HBO, PepsiCo, Domino’s and more, to design, build, and transform their digital products and strategies. We’re looking to grow our Poatek offices in Brazil with top talent excited to collaborate with team members across the globe to deliver innovative solutions for our clients.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role, which we’ve termed Work from Near (WFN). This model requires the ability to work on-site from our São Paulo - SP or Porto - RS office throughout the week based on team needs, while still providing the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

As a Tech Lead (Android), you will be at the forefront of our dynamic team, leading the design of applications, tools, and processes while ensuring value, clarity, and maintainability. Your role will involve expertly navigating and enhancing client tech stacks, executing large-scale refactors, and advocating for world-class engineering practices. You will be instrumental in driving teams to reduce change fail percentages, resolving conflicts, advocating for new practices, and tailoring your communication to diverse scenarios. Furthermore, you are expected to tackle psychological safety impediments and mentor team members, fostering a conducive work environment across the entire build cycle.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the team and client in designing applications, tools, and processes, optimizing for value, clarity, and maintainability.
  • Plan and drive execution of large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem, managing dependencies and minimizing risk.
  • Use your strong understanding of the Android development lifecycle and ecosystem to help the team navigate non-trivial testing scenarios, such as video streaming, Bluetooth, and other peripherals, poor network conditions, etc.
  • Champion the adoption and implementation of new practices for project teams and clients, while using IDE’s, version control like Git, and command line tools effectively.

Additional Responsibilities

On-Call Support: This role includes periodic on-call duties to support our critical systems. Aligned with our commitment to work-life balance, we maintain a strict 10-hour daily work limit, even during on-call periods. Team members may be required to respond to issues outside of regular business hours on a rotational basis. Compensation for on-call duty is provided in accordance with Brazilian labor laws.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience (10+ years) as an Android Engineer, with a track record of leading complex projects.
  • Expert knowledge in implementing world-class engineering practices.
  • Deep understanding of client tech stacks and the ability to integrate and improve them over a series of projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and execute large-scale refactors across the software ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of the Android development Lifecycle and ecosystem including languages, frameworks, and libraries (Java, Kotlin, Room, Coroutines/Flow, RxJava, Dagger 2, Gradle, Fragments, OkHttp3, Retrofit or Volley).
  • Comfort with IDE’s, version control systems such as Git, and command-line tools.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure, GitHub Actions) and experience setting up deployment pipelines.
  • Experience in frequently using frameworks such as Espresso, JUnit, Mockito/Mockk to write automated tests for your code.
  • Proven ability to recognize symptoms of various impediments to psychological safety and provide effective support.

Bonus Points

  • Expertise in choosing and executing deployment strategies that minimize risk and maximize client ROI.
  • Deep understanding and empathy for client hesitations around frequent releases, with proven strategies on how to overcome those hurdles.
  • Proven ability to balance helping and teaching with the need to finish things.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across a team to identify the level of support each team member needs in implementing different features.

Why Poatek?

What We Offer:

  • Be part of an innovative consultancy with a human-centered and culture with opportunities for ownership and professional growth
  • Competitive salary and benefits package (annual bonus)
  • Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities)
  • Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses,
  • Flexible work hours and autonomy
  • Voucher for health activities, food allowance, in-office snacks, drinks, and games

If you love IT as much as we do, we look forward to meeting you!

Equality is a principle here at Poatek. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing those information with us.

description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
  • Facilitate release activities across all releases, mainly with ensuring quality, timely deployments across environments
  • Maintains the release schedule for all core services and ensure alignment across key partners and vendors.
  • Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates
  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus
  • Knowledge on MS Project, Excel-Macros
  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
    Desired Technical Stack:
  • Platforms : Windows, Linux.
  • Database : MSSQL
  • Ticketing Tools: Service now
  • Cloud Environment : MS Azure
  • CI and Build Deployment Tools : Octopus Deploy
  • Version Control Tool : Azure Devops
  • Monitoring tools : Grafana
Additional Information

Monday to Friday - 08:00 to 17:00 Hybrid Work

description:
Job description

A melhor maneira de ir mais longe começa aqui.

Você sabia que a Michelin tem mais de 130 anos de história e está presente em mais de 170 países, sendo referência global em mobilidade segura, eficiente e sustentável? No Brasil, a Michelin atua há mais de 100 anos com tecnologia de ponta na fabricação de pneus, serviços e soluções inovadoras — sempre com foco na qualidade, segurança e respeito ao meio ambiente.

E como pessoas são o centro de tudo que fazemos, seguimos investindo na construção de um ambiente cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e inovador.

Pensando nisso, em parceria com o Instituto Primeira Geração (PriG) — organização que apoia pessoas que são a primeira geração de suas famílias a concluir o ensino superior — temos o orgulho de lançar o Programa Primeira Geração- Michelin 2025.

Voltado para pessoas recém-formadas no ensino superior, o programa oferece uma oportunidade única de desenvolvimento profissional, unindo a vivência prática de um estágio de pós-graduação na Michelin com um MBA prático, que será cursado ao longo do programa, relacionado à sua área de formação. Além disso, você contará com uma rede de apoio e aprendizado contínuo para impulsionar sua trajetória profissional.

Gostou? Então venha fazer parte da Michelin/PriG!

Quer conhecer mais sobre a Michelin? Seguem os canais:

Site : michelin.com.br/

Instagram : @michelinbrasil

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/michelin/


Main responsibilities

A área de P&D de Pneus para Ônibus e Caminhões é responsável por desenvolver soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis que atendam às necessidades dos clientes, com foco em segurança, performance e durabilidade. Nosso desafio é criar produtos que gerem valor para o cliente e para a empresa, contribuindo para sua competitividade e saúde econômica.

Com forte interface com as áreas de Marketing e Industrial, atuamos de forma colaborativa e global, em constante troca com times de desenvolvimento de outros continentes, buscando alinhamento e sinergia nas soluções técnicas.

E você desenvolverá as seguintes atividades:

  • Apoiar a equipe de desenvolvimento de produtos em todas as etapas dos projetos, contribuindo com atividades técnicas e operacionais;
  • Auxiliar na realização de simulações por elementos finitos (FEA), colaborando na análise estrutural e no estudo do comportamento dos pneus em diferentes condições de uso, com foco na otimização da performance e durabilidade;
  • Contribuir com a análise de produtos existentes no mercado, por meio de investigações técnicas sobre o desempenho e as características dos pneus já lançados;
  • Apoiar nas análises técnicas para identificação de causas relacionadas a problemas de desempenho, colaborando com sugestões de melhorias e ajustes no design;
  • Dar suporte na elaboração de relatórios e recomendações técnicas, com base nas análises realizadas, visando subsidiar a tomada de decisão com foco em performance, segurança e eficiência;
  • Colaborar com atividades transversais junto a outras áreas envolvidas no desenvolvimento de produtos, promovendo a integração e o alinhamento dos projetos;
  • Auxiliar na gestão de iniciativas relacionadas à excelência operacional, acompanhando o andamento das atividades e contribuindo para o cumprimento de prazos, processos e metas da equipe.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e qualificações obrigatórios :

  • Fazer parte da primeira geração da família a concluir o ensino superior;
  • Ter no máximo 4 anos de conclusão do ensino superior;
  • Graduação completa em Engenharia;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar 3 dias presenciais (Estrada da Cachamorra- Campo Grande / RJ) e 2 dias home-office.

Requisitos e qualificações desejáveis :

  • Conhecimento de ferramentas digitais e softwares 3Ds;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento de produtos técnicos, especialmente em engenharia, testes de performance ou processos industriais;
  • Experiencia com projetos;

Additional information

Como pessoa estagiária Michelin/PriG , você terá os seguintes benefícios:

Michelin

  • Bolsa auxílio;
  • Vale-transporte ou ônibus fretado (Diversas rotas na cidade do Rio de Janeiro)ou estacionamento no local;
  • Alimentação no local;
  • Clube de Vantagens (diferentes parceiros que nos oferecem descontos em produtos e serviços);
  • Clube de Funcionários (área de lazer com piscina, quadras poliesportivas, eventos mensais);
  • Seguro de Vida.

PriG

  • Em 18 meses, você cursará disciplinas de MBA na Descomplica;
  • Trilha de Desenvolvimento PriG;
  • Mentoria ou Coaching.

Technical Support Engineer

Position Summary:

Bentley Systems is seeking a talented individual to become a valued member of the Product Support team as aTechnical Support Engineer. As part of the Global Technical Support team, the technical support engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance on the product via (inbound/outbound) phone, e-mail, and web portal.This is a hands-on position that will interface with our users as well as our development, professional services, and sales departments. The position is responsible for problem analysis, documentation, resolution, and escalation involving Bentley’s supported products

We will rely on you for the following:

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.
  • Assist with all facets of Bentley users and technical support by helping to identify user issues by isolating and resolving the issue or by proper escalation.
  • Advise and educate users on accurate usage of the Product and address specific use cases reported on the Service Requests.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your daily tasks will look like this:

  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.
  • Contribute to Bentley Communities and answer user queries.
  • Update the Team Technical Knowledge Base and share updates with the team.
  • Upskill on Product Knowledge by focusing on a new topic every week. Consume Training through internal Pathways, Wikis, videos, etc.
  • Channelize potential Defects/Enhancements to the Product Management/Development teams.
  • Provide a handover to the next shift with appropriate documentation when needed

What You Bring to The Team:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support and exposure to global user interaction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience or Knowledge with ProjectWise product suites or similar document management systems such as Documentum, Vault or Aconex.
  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction.
  • Competitive Salary and benefits.
  • The opportunity to work within a global and diverse international team.
  • A supportive and collaborative environment.
  • Colleague Recognition Awards.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.
What You Will Do

  • Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  • Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  • Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  • Performs advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis
  • Assists qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Suports Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Implements and maintains ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience:
  • Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  • Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX , ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  • Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  • Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  • Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  • Professional or chartered engineering license
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  • Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  • Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.
It Would Be Nice If You Have:
  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.
Reporting Relationships:
The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Flutter Pleno / Sênior
description:
Tecnologia é o que nos move e faz a empresa crescer de forma acelerada. Ela começa na base de tudo - nas motos, cada uma sai da nossa garagem equipada com um IoT para garantir segurança e suporte 24/7 para os entregadores, e nos ajudar a tomar melhores decisões de negócio.
Todos os nossos sistemas foram desenvolvidos dentro de casa, tanto os softwares utilizados internamente, para gestão da frota, manutenção e atendimento a clientes, quanto nosso app e plataforma de delivery.
Já nascemos uma empresa 100% cloud, com tecnologias e boas práticas do mercado.
Mas, como toda empresa tech, já estamos de olho na nossa próxima mudança e evolução, onde todos nossos sistemas vão para uma nova arquitetura de serviços, dando mais liberdade para as equipes explorarem novas tecnologias e linguagens de programação.
No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Projetar, desenvolver, testar e documentar aplicações móveis com Flutter;
  • Participar ativamente das discussões de escopo junto ao PM e contribuir na priorização das tarefas com foco total na experiência do cliente;
  • Investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados à escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e confiabilidade das aplicações;
  • Colaborar com o time utilizando ferramentas como Jira para gestão de tarefas e GitHub para versionamento de código
O que esperamos de você:
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Dart e no ecossistema Flutter;
  • Domínio em integrações com APIs RESTful;
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e disposição para aprender e ensinar;
  • Proatividade para identificar e propor melhorias constantes;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos arquiteturais e boas práticas em aplicações móveis, especialmente com foco em arquitetura modular, iOS, Android e WEB.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência com GetX para gerenciamento de estado e navegação;
  • Vivência com plataformas móveis nativas (Android/iOS);
  • Conhecimentos em Kotlin e Swift;
  • Familiaridade com funcionalidades core do Android, como localização, câmera, entre outras;
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile, como React Native ou Xamarin;
  • Experiência com processos de CI/CD e automações de build e deploy para ambientes de teste e produção;
  • Conhecimento em NestJS e arquitetura BFF (Backend for Frontend).
SOBRE A MOTTU
Nós da Mottu acreditamos no poder de transformar vidas através da mobilidade e da inovação. Fundada em 2020, somos hoje a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, com mais de 100.000 motos em circulação e presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México. Em setembro de 2023, concluímos nossa rodada Series C de US$ 50 milhões, liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital, como Crankstart Foundation, Bicycle Capital e QED Investors.
Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para atingir o status de unicórnio ainda em 2025. Acreditamos em um mundo conectado e simplificado, com soluções tecnológicas que melhoram vidas. Valorizamos a superação, a igualdade e a união para construir juntos e transformar a forma como pensamos e agimos. Nós somos Mottu.
Nossos princípios inspiram cada passo da nossa trajetória e guiam nossas ações. Acreditamos no medo de ser mediano e, por isso, não nos conformamos com nada menos do que o excepcional: pensar grande e pensar pequeno dá o mesmo trabalho, então damos cada dia 10% a mais do que conseguimos dar no anterior, sempre buscando a grandeza e a escalabilidade. Nosso Foco no Cliente é inegociável, pois nascemos para dar oportunidade a quem nunca teve uma e somos obstinados em ajudá-los a conquistar seus sonhos. Mantemos a Cabeça de Dono, tomando decisões com coragem, autonomia e responsabilidade para deixar um legado com paixão e “sangue nos olhos”. Com Mão na Graxa, arregaçamos as mangas e fazemos nós mesmos para entender e melhorar cada processo, respeitando sempre a opinião de quem está na ponta da lança. E atuamos Ombro a Ombro, apoiando-nos mutuamente, cultivando relações genuínas, sinceras e duradouras, com a coragem de falar a verdade — afinal, aqui não há espaço para jogar em primeira pessoa.
Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e deseja fazer parte da nossa missão de revolucionar a mobilidade, a Mottu é o lugar certo para você! Venha somar ao time e construir conosco o futuro da mobilidade na América Latina.
